releases.body:
## Changes

- Rename package and plugin identity to opencode-model-scorecard.
- Add benchmark-backed token-efficiency context and details dialog support.
- Add README, CI, issue templates, adoption documentation, and a real Terminal/OpenCode TUI GIF capture for public discovery.
- Update the GIF to demonstrate switching between complete-data models, with score/cost/efficiency changing from MiniMax-M2.7 to GLM-5.2 and back before opening Model Benchmark details.
- Record live discovery submissions for OpenCode ecosystem, awesome-opencode, and opencode.cafe.

## Validation

- npm test
- npm run pack:dry-run
- isolated opencode plugin install using OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR
- real Terminal capture of OpenCode TUI model switching with no n/a score fields
- GitHub Actions CI passing on the release commit: https://github.com/bnc4vk/opencode-model-scorecard/actions/runs/28707723375
